issues.detail: Spec does not state clock-edge polarity; contract hard-codes posedge without uncertainty.
issues.spec_evidence: Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0).
issues.alternative: Negedge-triggered D flip-flop: q updates on falling clk edge instead of rising; after the second row at a posedge, q would remain 0 rather than become 1.
